SELECT 
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / 750, 2) as percentage_neutral,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as marvel_neutral_count
FROM superhero sh 
JOIN alignment a ON sh.alignment_id = a.id 
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
